definitions.explanation: A component of a kanji character used to classify it in dictionaries. Radicals often indicate the meaning category of a character.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部首|ぶしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦さんずい→さんずい：09495_sanzui⟧」⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{部首|ぶしゅ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can look up characters by radical in a kanji dictionary.

examples.japanese: {部首|ぶしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かりやすく→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you learn the radicals, it becomes easier to understand the meanings of kanji.

notes:
{部首|ぶしゅ} are the building blocks used to classify kanji in dictionaries. There are 214 traditional radicals.

Common radicals and their names:
- ⟦{氵|さんずい}→さんずい：09495_sanzui⟧ - water radical
- ⟦{亻|にんべん}→にんべん：23624_ninben⟧ - person radical
- ⟦{木|きへん}→きへん：23625_kihen⟧ - tree radical
- ⟦{扌|てへん}→てへん：noentry⟧ - hand radical
- ⟦{艹|くさかんむり}→くさかんむり：noentry⟧ - grass crown

Learning radicals helps with:
- Looking up kanji in dictionaries
- Understanding kanji meanings (semantic clues)
- Memorizing new kanji

Related terms:
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧ (kanji)
- ⟦{画数|かくすう}→画数：13581_kakusuu⟧ (stroke count)
